info.title: CyberGIS Application API (auth, admin, catalog, exports)
info.description:
Application API of the CyberGIS platform (Agent 5): **accounts and roles**, **admin dataset hosting**
(upload → validate → publish → version status), **catalog discovery** and **full/clipped exports**.
This is a project API, **not** an OGC API standard; OGC API Features/Tiles stay at `/ogc/`.

### Roles
| Role | May |
|---|---|
| anonymous | `GET /auth/me`, `GET /api/exports/capabilities`, discover datasets whose access level is `public` |
| `user` | discover/export datasets with access `public` or `users`; manage own tokens/password |
| `admin` | everything a user may, plus `/admin/*` (upload, validate, publish, discard, access policy, jobs) |

Authorization is enforced by this service on every route (and can be enforced at the gateway with
`GET /auth/verify`); hiding a button in a UI is never the control.

### Authentication
* **Browser**: `POST /auth/login {username, password}` sets the `cgis_session` cookie (HttpOnly,
  SameSite=Strict, Secure on HTTPS) and returns `csrf_token`. Send `X-CSRF-Token: <csrf_token>` on every
  POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE. `GET /auth/me` returns the token again after a page reload.
* **Scripts**: `POST /auth/login {…, "token": true}` returns `access_token`; send `Authorization: Bearer …`.
* **QGIS / GDAL / long-lived clients**: `POST /auth/tokens` creates a personal access token (`read` scope by
  default). Use it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` or as the *password* of HTTP Basic (any username).
  Account passwords are never accepted through HTTP Basic.
* Credentials in the query string are refused (`400 SECRET_IN_URL`).
* Sessions expire after `APP_SESSION_TTL_SECONDS` (default 8 h) or `APP_SESSION_IDLE_SECONDS` of
  inactivity (default 1 h). Logout, password change, role change and account disabling revoke sessions.

### Errors
Every error is `{"error": {"code", "message", "details"?}}`. 401 = no/expired/revoked credentials
(`UNAUTHENTICATED`, `SESSION_EXPIRED`, `SESSION_REVOKED`, `INVALID_TOKEN`, `INVALID_CREDENTIALS`);
403 = authenticated but not allowed (`FORBIDDEN`, `CSRF_FAILED`, `ORIGIN_FORBIDDEN`); 404 also hides datasets
the caller may not see.

### Jobs
`queued → running → completed | failed | cancelled`; exports later become `expired` when their retention
elapses. `progress` is 0..1 (null = indeterminate). A job interrupted by a worker restart is resumed from
scratch up to `APP_JOB_MAX_ATTEMPTS` times.

### Pagination
List endpoints take `offset` and `limit` and return `{items, total, offset, limit, links.next?}`.

post.summary: Upload a dataset version (alias of POST /admin/datasets/uploads)
post.description:
Multipart upload (admin only). Parts: ``metadata`` (JSON text of UploadMetadata) and ``file``
(GeoTIFF/COG ``.tif``/``.tiff`` or GeoJSON ``.geojson``/``.json``). The file is streamed to a server-named
staging file (limits: rasters ``APP_MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES``, GeoJSON ``APP_MAX_VECTOR_UPLOAD_BYTES``) and then
validated asynchronously by the importer.

* 202: new upload; poll ``links.self`` (``kind=upload``) until ``completed`` (validated) or ``failed``.
* 200: identical bytes already uploaded or ready for this version (idempotent; no new job).
* 409 ``CHECKSUM_CONFLICT``: the version is ready with different bytes - use a new version.
* 409 ``VERSION_EXISTS``: a different file for this version is staged/validating/validated - discard it first.

access.title: Access
access.description: public: anonymous discovery, any signed-in user may export; users: signed-in users; admins: administrators only.

code.title: Code
code.description: Stable machine-readable code, e.g. UNAUTHENTICATED, VERSION_EXISTS.

message.title: Message
message.description: Human-readable message (never contains paths, SQL or secrets).

version.title: Version
version.description: Omit for the current ready version.

aoi.title: Aoi
aoi.description: GeoJSON Polygon/MultiPolygon (or Feature); required for kind=clip, refused for kind=full.

output_crs.title: Output Crs
output_crs.description: EPSG:<code>; omit for the native CRS.

token.title: Token
token.description: false (browsers): set an HttpOnly session cookie and return a CSRF token. true (scripts): return a bearer access_token instead; no cookie.

csrf_token.title: Csrf Token
csrf_token.description: Browser sessions only: echo as X-CSRF-Token on every POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE.

access_token.title: Access Token
access_token.description: Only when login used token=true. Send as 'Authorization: Bearer <access_token>'.

scope.title: Scope
scope.description: read: catalog/OGC/tiles/exports as role 'user'. admin: also admin routes (admin accounts only).

token.title: Token
token.description: Shown ONCE. Use 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' (or HTTP Basic with any username and the token as password, for clients without header support).

sessionCookie.name: cgis_session
sessionCookie.description: Browser session from POST /auth/login. Unsafe methods also need the X-CSRF-Token header.

bearer.description: access_token from POST /auth/login (token=true) or a personal access token.

tokenBasic.description: Any username + a personal access token as the password (QGIS/GDAL).
